turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Leo!! How was the trip up north?

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: So good. Sam and I did four days in Door County, cherry pie every single day. I am now 40% cherry.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Jealous. I spent my week doing discharge paperwork and wondering what I'm doing with my life.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Uh oh. Work stuff?

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Kind of. I've been at Lakeview Pediatric Rehab for four years and I love the kids, but I think I'm done with Chicago winters.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Where would you even go?

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Denver. Grace is in Santa Fe, so I'd be closer to her, and mountains. I've started applying for pediatric PT jobs out there.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Wow. Okay, selfishly no. But honestly it sounds right for you.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Speaking of Grace: she got ENGAGED. Daniel proposed at Bandelier last month, at sunrise.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Stop!! Tell her congrats from me and Sam. Daniel's the one who teaches welding?

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Yes, at the community college there. They're thinking spring next year for the wedding.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Back-to-school panic over here. First day is August 25 and I'm teaching AP Chemistry for the first time.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Look at you! How many sections?

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: One AP section and three regular chem. And I'm still advising the science club.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: You'll be great. Remember when you singed your eyebrows in college?

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: That was ONE time and it was a demonstration.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Okay, honest question. Would it be insane to leave a job I like for a city where I know one person?

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Grace is a short flight from Denver, that counts as half a person.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Ha. I just feel stuck. Same apartment by the Belmont stop for five years, same commute, same climbing gym.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: You've been talking about mountains since college.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: I have, haven't I.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Do it. Apply. Worst case you say no.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Okay. Three applications this week. Hold me to it.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Holding. Meanwhile I'm setting up my classroom at Ashby High. I found a box of beakers from 1987.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Vintage glassware! Very Sam.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Sam Rivera, design snob, would approve. He wants one for the kitchen.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: How's your commute this year?

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Still the Blue Line plus a ten-minute walk. Forty minutes door to door.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Podcast time.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Exactly. Send recommendations.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Big news: I officially have a sourdough starter. His name is Gus.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Gus! Of course he's a Gus.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Day five. He smells like nail polish remover, which the internet says is normal.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Feed him, love him. I call dibs on the first loaf.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Also I signed up for the Prairie Lights Half Marathon. It's April 19. Registration opened yesterday and I panicked and clicked.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Amazing. Is that the one along the lake?

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Lakefront to the Riverwalk, 13.1 miles. I'm at about 20 miles a week right now.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: You'll crush it. I've got two video interviews next week, Aspen Lane Children's Therapy and a hospital outpatient clinic.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Aspen Lane sounds cute.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: It's a pediatric outpatient practice, lots of early intervention. Honestly that's my dream job.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: When are the interviews?

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Tuesday and Thursday. I'm wearing my one blazer.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: The green one? Power blazer.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: The green one.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Sam says good luck too. He's doing a branding project for a bakery at Northpaw Studio, so he keeps bringing home croissants 'for research'.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Sam's job is the best job.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: First week done at Ashby. I survived.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Tell me about the AP kids.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: They're intense. One kid, Priyanka, already found a typo in my syllabus. On day two.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: She's going to be your favorite.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Shh. Teachers don't have favorites.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Interview recap: Aspen Lane went great, the hospital clinic felt cold. Aspen Lane invited me for an on-site in Denver!

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: WHAT. When?

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Thursday, September 4. I'm flying out Wednesday night and back Friday.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Want me to water your plants?

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Yes please, the fiddle-leaf fig is dramatic. Key is with the doorman.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: I'll talk to it nicely.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Labor Day plans?

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Sam's family barbecue in Pilsen. His mom makes the best elote.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Bring me one.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: I'm back from Denver!! The on-site interview at Aspen Lane was Thursday.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: How'd it go?!

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: I think really well. The clinic director, Dr. Priscilla Grant, showed me around. They have a sensory gym and a tiny climbing wall.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: That sounds like heaven for you.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: It is. I also walked around Highland. Cute coffee shops, close to a big park. If I move, I want to live there.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: How was the altitude?

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: I got winded on one flight of stairs, lol.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: School started. My AP class has 28 kids and they're terrifyingly smart.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Any troublemakers?

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: One already asked if we could make thermite. No.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: My department head is Rosa Duarte. She's great, she gave me her old AP lab binder.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Treasure it.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Gus made his first loaf. It was a brick, but a delicious brick.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Brick bread is still bread.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Also my knee clicked a bit on my long run, but whatever.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Hmm. Don't 'whatever' your knee.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Hard day. One of my kiddos at Lakeview took his first independent steps today and I cried in the supply closet.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Happy crying or sad crying?

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Happy! He's been working on it for a year. This is why I can't leave without a goodbye party.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: When does your Chicago lease end, by the way?

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: December 31. So if Denver happens, I'd want to go before then.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Makes sense. My parents are visiting next weekend, Mom wants the full tour of my classroom.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Joan in a chemistry lab. Hide the Bunsen burners.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: She'll want to label everything. Dad just wants to see the new stadium downtown.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: How's the science club?

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Twelve kids signed up, double last year. We're doing a trip to the water reclamation plant in October.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Romantic.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: My dad works for the water utility, so he's thrilled.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Sam and I had our 5-year anniversary on Thursday! Dinner at Marigold Room, the tasting menu.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Five years!! Congrats, you two.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: He got me a framed print of the periodic table in his own hand lettering. Nerd love.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Adorable. Okay, I need a new podcast for my commute, the train has been a nightmare.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Taking requests or giving recommendations?

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Giving: you HAVE to listen to Lamplight Hours. It's interviews with people who work night shifts. The episode with the bridge operator made me cry.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Noted. Lamplight Hours.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: It starts slow, give it three episodes.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: How are your parents taking the Denver idea?

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Mom's fine. Dad keeps sending me articles about Denver housing prices.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Classic Paul.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: He also offered to drive the moving truck if I go. So, mixed messages.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: How's Grace's planning?

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: They're thinking May. She wants an outdoor courtyard venue in Santa Fe.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Sam and I are coming. I don't care if we're invited.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: You're invited, obviously.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Thank you for hosting Grace and Daniel tonight! They loved your place.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: They're great. Daniel and Sam talked about fonts for an hour.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Daniel has opinions about everything. Also thank you for checking about the shellfish.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Of course. Daniel's allergy is no joke.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: And Grace's celiac. You made the gluten-free bread without complaining.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Gus was offended, but I did it.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: They're flying back to Santa Fe Sunday. Grace is touring venues next week.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: She mentioned Casa something?

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Casa Lumbre is her favorite. It has a courtyard with old cottonwood trees.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Sounds gorgeous.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Also she asked me to be her maid of honor!! Tonight, in your bathroom, lol.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: The most romantic location. Congrats!

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: LEO. I GOT THE JOB.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: AHHH! Aspen Lane??

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Aspen Lane! Dr. Grant called yesterday afternoon. Pediatric physical therapist, start date January 12.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: I'm so proud of you. Okay, I'm a little sad. Mostly proud.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Same. They're giving me $3,000 for the relocation.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: When are you moving?

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: The plan is to drive out the weekend of December 13. My last day at Lakeview will be December 12.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: That's soon.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: I know. I'm already making spreadsheets.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: We have to celebrate. Brunch at our place next Saturday, then Hoshizora for dinner? Too much food?

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Never too much food. Saturday the 11th, yes.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Sam will make his frittata.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Also I'm keeping it secret at work until I give notice on the 15th.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: My lips are sealed.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Told my parents about the offer properly. Mom is planning to visit me in Denver in February.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Linda in Denver! She'll reorganize your kitchen.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: She already sent me a list of 'Denver essentials'. Item one: humidifier.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Altitude skin, she's not wrong.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: What's new with you?

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: We had a minor lab incident. A kid knocked over a beaker of copper sulfate. Everyone's fine, the floor is blue now.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: A blue floor is a feature.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: The janitor disagrees. Also the science club trip got moved to October 24 because the bus fell through.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Is your dad still coming?

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Yes, he's coming as a guest expert, he's been practicing his water-pressure jokes.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Yesterday was perfect. Sam's frittata, ramen, and you didn't even make fun of my slurping.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Your slurping is a love language.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Hoshizora on Milwaukee Avenue is still the best ramen in Chicago, I will die on this hill. Spicy miso with an extra egg, every time.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: I know your order better than mine at this point.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: And THANK YOU for lending me The Salt Orchard. I'm already 50 pages in.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: It's my signed copy, so guard it with your life. Imogen Vale signed it at the book fair two years ago.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: With my life. And with my future dog's life.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Wait, you're getting a dog?

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Thinking about it. Maybe after the move. A greyhound, they're couch potatoes.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Sam wants a dog too, but our lease says no dogs.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Boo.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: My birthday's on the 30th, by the way, so I expect a card.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: A card AND something. You're turning 33, that's a big one.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Is it?

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: It's whatever I say it is.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Gave notice on Wednesday. My boss was sad but happy for me. They're doing a goodbye lunch on my last day.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: December 12, right?

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Yep. Then a week of packing chaos.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Parent-teacher conferences this week for me. Eleven parents asked if AP Chem is 'curved'.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Is it?

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Chemistry is not curved, chemistry is consequences.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Put that on a mug.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: The science club trip to the water plant is Friday. My dad is coming as a guest expert, he's so excited.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Mike in his element! Take a picture.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Sam finished the bakery branding. The logo is a croissant with little legs.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: I need a shirt with that on it.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Halloween question: is a periodic table costume too teacher?

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Yes. Do it anyway.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: The kids are going to roast me.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: I'm going as a sourdough loaf, in honor of Gus.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Gus is honored.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: How's training?

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Did 11 miles yesterday. My knee hurt the last two miles, on the outside of it.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Outside of the knee? That's often the IT band. Foam roll, and if it keeps hurting see someone.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Yes, Dr. Cho.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: I'm serious, I see this all the time in teen runners.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Okay, okay. Also Rosa asked me to coordinate the school science fair in February.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: That's a lot on top of AP.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: It's February 12. I said yes before thinking.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Classic Leo.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Wait, you said something weird happened at your work potluck?

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Oh! Yesterday at Kim's potluck my throat got super itchy after the pesto. I think it had cashews in it.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: That's scary. Are you okay?

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Fine now. I'm seeing an allergist on Thursday.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Allergist results: I'm allergic to cashews. And pistachios, because apparently they're related.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Oh no, the pesto.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: The pesto. She gave me an epinephrine pen to carry, just in case.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Okay, cashews and pistachios are officially banned from my kitchen when you visit.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Thank you. Good thing I'm vegetarian anyway and skip most mystery sauces.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: How long have you been vegetarian again?

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Since sophomore year of college, so twelve years.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Also thank you for the birthday card and the socks!

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Did they fit? They're the merino running ones.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Perfect. Sam made me lasagna and a cake shaped like a beaker.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Of course he did.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: The knee still hurts after about 6 miles.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Please see a PT.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: I booked one. Renee Walsh at Kinetic Way PT, a week from Tuesday.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Good. Report back.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Friendsgiving planning! November 22 at our place, 6 pm. You're coming, right?

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Obviously. What can I bring?

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Sam is doing the turkey, I'm doing sourdough stuffing. Alex Moreau is bringing two pies.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: I'll bring my mushroom wellington. The vegetarians need a main.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Perfect. We'll have about twelve people.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Is Rosa coming?

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Rosa and her wife, yes. And Sam's coworker Marisol.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: I'll make two wellingtons then.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Also cashew-free everything. I'm labeling the dishes.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: You're the best host.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: I signed a lease in Denver! Remotely, which is terrifying. A one-bedroom in Baker, move-in December 15.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Baker? I thought you wanted Highland.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Highland was too expensive this month. Baker is fine, it's near the light rail.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Photos?

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: It's on the third floor, a walk-up, but it has a huge window and a radiator that hisses.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Hissing radiators are character.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: My parents want me to come to Naperville for a goodbye dinner on December 7.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Will you be done packing by then?

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Ha. No.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Gus update: he's thriving. I made a cinnamon raisin loaf.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Save me a slice. Forever.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: And Sam got promoted to senior designer!

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: SAM!!! Tell him congrats from me.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Meet Juniper. JUNI. I adopted her yesterday!

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: WHAT. Photo NOW.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: [photo] Retired racing greyhound, four years old, from Second Lap Greyhound Rescue.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: She's so elegant. And so long.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: She sleeps 18 hours a day. She's terrified of slippery floors and of thunder, apparently storms make her shake.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Poor baby.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: She also won't do stairs yet. Which is a problem with a third-floor walk-up in Denver...

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Oh no.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: I'm working on it.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: PT update: Renee says it's IT band syndrome.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Called it.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Long runs are capped at 6 miles for now, and after that I can add no more than one mile per week. Foam rolling and clamshells every day.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Listen to Renee.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: I'm listening. Grumpily.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: The half is April 19, you have time.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: What does Juni eat?

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Salmon and sweet potato kibble. She has a sensitive stomach.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Rough news. My grandma fell on Wednesday and broke her hip. She had a hip replacement yesterday in LA.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Oh Maddie. I'm so sorry. How is she?

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Surgery went okay. She's 84 and stubborn, which helps. I'm flying to LA on Monday for Thanksgiving week to help my aunt.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Do you need anything? Who's taking Juni?

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: That's the thing... could Juni stay with you and Sam? Monday to Sunday the 30th.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Of course. Our landlord said a visiting dog is fine for a week.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: You're the best. I'll bring her bed, her food and her coat.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Still coming to Friendsgiving tonight?

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Yes! I'm bringing the mushroom wellington. No cashews in it, I checked twice.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Ha. See you at 6.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Grandma's name is Sun-ja, by the way. She'll want to know who's dog-sitting.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: How's my girl?

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Juni is perfect. She stole half a loaf of Gus bread off the counter and then slept on Sam for six hours.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: OMG, I'm so sorry.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Sam says she lives here now.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Grandma update: she's in a rehab facility, walking with a walker a little more each day. Her physical therapists are impressed, and I'm being very annoying about her form.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Ha, of course you are.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Thanksgiving was at my aunt Mi-young's. Lots of food, lots of opinions.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Speaking of family: my dad's retirement party is set. Saturday December 13, in Milwaukee.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Mike is retiring?! After how long?

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: 34 years at the water utility. Mom is throwing a party at the VFW hall and I'm giving a speech.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: You'll make everyone cry.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: That's the goal.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: I fly back tomorrow at 2, so I'll pick Juni up Sunday evening.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Picked up Juni! She didn't want to leave Sam.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Sam is in mourning. He keeps looking at the spot where her bed was.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Grandma is still in rehab. My aunt will visit every day and send me updates.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: That's good.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: I sold my couch to my coworker Kim for $200. I'm now sitting on a yoga mat.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Very minimalist.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Also the movers quoted $4,000, so Dad and I are doing the rental truck instead.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Paul to the rescue.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: He's already planning snack stops.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Bad news on the Denver front. The Baker apartment fell through. The landlord sold the building and the new owner is renovating.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Ugh! What now?

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: I'm pushing the move to January 3. I'll stay here until then, my Chicago lease runs through the end of December anyway.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Okay, selfishly that's good. More time with us.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: AND I found a new place. A one-bedroom in Highland, ground floor, so no stairs for Juni.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Highland after all! Fate.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: It's a bit more expensive, but worth it. Move-in is January 2.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: I'm helping you pack. When?

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Saturday the 20th?

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Done. Sam can't, he has his work holiday party that day, but I'll bring snacks.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Also Grace and Daniel set the date: May 16, at Casa Lumbre in Santa Fe. A save-the-date is coming.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Sam and I are there.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: You're both on the list. It'll be outdoors, in the courtyard.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: And the goodbye dinner at your parents' is tomorrow, right? Good luck.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Pray for me.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Help. I have to write a retirement speech for my dad and everything I write is either cheesy or a water pun.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Lean into the water puns. It's his whole career.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: 'Dad, you've kept this city flowing for 34 years'?

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Perfect. Then something sincere at the end, about him teaching you to fix the bike.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Oh, the bike. Yes. That's the ending.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: My last day at Lakeview is Friday. They're doing a goodbye lunch and the kids made me a card with Juni on it.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Stop, I'm going to cry before Saturday.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: I'll still be in Chicago until January 3, so this isn't goodbye yet.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Good. I'm not ready.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Dad's party was yesterday. I cried during my own speech.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Of course you did. How was it?

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: 80 people at the VFW hall. Mom made a slideshow of Dad with every mustache he's ever had.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Iconic.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: And then my brother Alex stood up and announced that Hana is pregnant. Baby girl, due April 20!

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: AHH! You're going to be an uncle!

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Uncle Leo. I'm going to be so annoying.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: You'll be teaching her chemistry at age two.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Dad says he's going to spend his retirement building her a crib in the garage.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Mike and woodworking, I love it.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: How was your goodbye dinner?

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Mom cried. Dad gave me a printed map of Denver with the grocery stores highlighted.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Paul is a gift.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Thank you for helping me pack yesterday. You are a box-taping machine.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Your labeling system is unhinged. 'Kitchen-ish'? 'Misc but important'?

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: It's a system!

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Bad news though... I think you packed The Salt Orchard.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Oh no. I did. It's in 'Books (fragile)'. I'll mail it back as soon as I'm in Denver, I promise.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: It's signed!!

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: I KNOW. It's safe.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Okay, planning thing: come visit in February? Presidents' Day weekend. I found a cabin in Elk Hollow, about two hours from Denver.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: YES. February 14 to 16?

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Yes. It's Valentine's weekend, so we're each other's dates.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Sam can't come, he's got a conference that weekend anyway.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Next time. The deposit is $150, we'll split it.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Deal.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: My dad and I are driving the rental truck out on January 2 and 3. Juni gets the passenger seat on day two.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Wait, didn't you sell your car?

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Sold it last week! I'll buy something used in Denver.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Merry belated Christmas!! Did Sam like his gift?

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: He loved the drafting lamp. And thank you for the cast-iron pan!! Twelve inches of pure love.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Season it before you use it!

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Already seasoned twice. Gus and the pan are best friends.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Thank you for the Denver guidebook and Juni's winter coat. She looks like a tiny superhero.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Red was the right call.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: What are you doing for New Year's Eve?

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Alex Moreau's party, as always. His game nights are getting intense.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Can I come? My last Chicago New Year's.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Obviously. Juni too.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Juni will sleep under the snack table.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Happy New Year!! Is Juni recovered from the party?

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: She's asleep on the one cushion I haven't packed. You?

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Sam is making hangover pancakes. You won the trivia round, by the way, Alex Moreau is still mad.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: As he should be. Thank you for a perfect last night in Chicago.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Not crying, you're crying.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Truck pickup is tomorrow at 8. Dad lands at O'Hare tonight.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Text me from the road. Every state line.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Illinois, Iowa, Nebraska, Colorado. Four texts, I promise.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: I made it!! We got in Saturday night. 14 hours of driving with Juni sighing in the back.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Welcome to Denver!! How's the place?

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Small but cozy. New address: 1418 Larkspur Ct, Apt 1, Denver, CO 80211.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Saved.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: And I got a Colorado number: (720) 555-0164. My old Chicago number, (312) 555-0119, shuts off on February 1.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Updating my contacts right now.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Juni loves the ground floor. She's already claimed the window.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Did your dad survive the drive?

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: He flew home yesterday. He made me promise to get snow tires.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Also the cabin is booked! Elk Hollow, February 14 to 16. I paid the $150 deposit, you owe me $75 whenever.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: I'll send it this week.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: No rush.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Unpacking update: 60% done. The 'Misc but important' box was mostly cables.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Called it.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: My upstairs neighbor is a retired music teacher named Gloria. She plays piano at 9 am every day. It's lovely, actually.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Free concerts.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Juni's new vet is Dr. Ruth Fenn at Highland Vet Clinic. Juni was dramatic about the scale.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Of course she was.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: My semester started on Tuesday. AP kids came back from break and forgot everything about equilibrium.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Equilibrium is a state of mind.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Not on the exam it isn't.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: First day tomorrow. I'm nervous. What if the kids hate me?

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Kids love you. You're basically a human trampoline.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: True.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: My news: I'm applying to the MEd in Science Education at Lakemont University. The application is due January 15.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Leo! That's great. Part-time?

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Part-time, evenings, so I can keep teaching. Two years.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Want me to read your personal statement?

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Yes please. Sending it tonight. It's too long.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: I'll cut it with love.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Knee update: I'm back up to 8-mile long runs and it's holding.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Following Renee's rule?

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: One mile a week, religiously.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Week one survived! I love it here.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Tell me everything.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: I work Monday to Thursday, 7 to 5:30, ten-hour days, and I get Fridays off. Fridays off, Leo!

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: That's the dream.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: My caseload is mostly toddlers. Dr. Grant is the best boss I've ever had.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: And a coworker, Tasha Reid, already adopted me. She showed me Little Kettle Coffee, around the corner from my place.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: You found your coffee shop in week one. Classic.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Their oat latte is perfect. Also I signed up for a pottery class! Thursday evenings at Clayhouse Studio.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Pottery! Make me something.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: I'm going to make you a mug. It will be ugly.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: I'll treasure it.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: I submitted the Lakemont application on Wednesday. Your edits made it so much better.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Proud of you.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Also Sam and I are apartment hunting. Our lease ends February 28.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Find one that allows dogs.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: That's literally criterion number one.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: MEd update: Rosa and Principal Hughes both wrote my recommendation letters. Hughes called me 'relentlessly curious'.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Accurate. Is that a compliment?

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: I'm choosing to read it as one.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: First real patient win today: a two-year-old who wouldn't put weight on her left foot took four steps to her mom.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: That's amazing.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: I cried in the supply closet again. Some things don't change with the zip code.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Also Tasha talked me into joining Basecamp Climbing. Tuesday nights.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Back on the wall!

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: My forearms are already screaming.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: My AP kids have a mock exam on February 3. I'm more nervous than they are.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Grandma update: she's been home since January 16! She walks with a cane now and does PT twice a week.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: That's amazing!! Tell her a stranger in Chicago is cheering.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: She asked if you're the dog-sitter. She's a fan.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Juni and I have a bond.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: We found an apartment! A two-bedroom in Avondale, dogs allowed, with a back porch. We signed yesterday.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Yay!! When do you move?

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: February 21.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: A dog is coming, I can feel it.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Sam has already named it. Pickle.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Perfect.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Science fair prep is eating my life. 42 projects this year.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: When is it again?

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: February 12. Then I sleep for a week.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: My radiator is making noises like a ghost choir.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Hissing is character, I told you.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: The landlord, Mr. Ortega, says he'll send someone Monday.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Also I bought a car! A used gray hatchback. Juni approves of the back seat.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Snow tires?

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Dad would disown me otherwise. Yes, snow tires.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: I had my last PT session yesterday. Renee discharged me.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Graduation! Keep doing the exercises.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Clamshells for life.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Pottery class tonight was so fun. I made a bowl that looks like a hat.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Family calendar dump. Alex and Hana's baby shower is Saturday March 14, 2 pm, at Hana's parents' house in Evanston.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Cute! Are guys allowed at showers now?

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: It's co-ed. Hana's mom is going all out.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: And Alex Moreau is hosting game night on Saturday March 7.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Ugh, I miss game night. Tell Alex M I miss it, and that he still owes me a rematch.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Will do.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Also help: Sam's birthday is Saturday the 7th. Record player or vintage film camera?

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Camera. 100%. He's been taking photos of everything lately.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Camera it is.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Oh, and I got an interview for the MEd! February 25.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: LEO!!!

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: In person, at Lakemont, 4 pm.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Wear the blue sweater.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Mom confirmed her Denver visit: February 20 to 23. She's bringing a suitcase of Korean side dishes.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Linda's banchan! You're so lucky.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: The radiator guy finally came on Monday. It's quiet now. I almost miss the ghost choir.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Character lost.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Mock exam results: class average 3.4 out of 5. Priyanka got a 5, of course.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Told you she'd be your favorite.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Shh.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Also I have a date on Saturday. Don't make it weird.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: I would never. (I will.)

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Sam LOVED the camera. He's already shot a whole roll of the cat next door.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Told you.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Bad news: there's a huge snowstorm forecast for next weekend. The road up to Elk Hollow might close.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Oh no.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: The owner offered to move us to March 27 to 29, no charge. The deposit carries over.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Let's do it. March 27 to 29.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Done, moved. You still owe me $75, by the way.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: I know, I know.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Also you're on breakfast duty. Bring your sourdough and that cast-iron pan I gave you.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Gus and the pan are coming.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: There's no Wi-Fi up there, just a wood stove, so bring books.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Fine by me.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Unrelated: I went on a date. Ethan. He's a nurse, we met at trivia night.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: !!! Details.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Later. It was nice. Really nice.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: The science fair was yesterday and I'm alive.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: How'd it go?

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: One of my teams won a spot at regionals. Water filtration with sand and charcoal.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Amazing!!

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Rosa bought the whole department pizza.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Valentine's plans?

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Sam is cooking. Then we're packing boxes, very romantic.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Ethan's taking me to dinner tomorrow. Since the cabin got moved, I'm free.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Look at you.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Juni is suspicious of him.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Juni has good instincts. Keep me posted.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Snow day, everything's closed. Juni refuses to go outside.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Smart dog.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Grace sent pictures from her dress fitting. She's going to look stunning.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Is she doing a big bridal party?

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Just me and Daniel's sister Lucia. I'm maid of honor, so I have to give a toast. Help.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: I'll help you write it. Funny or sappy?

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Both.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: My dad started a woodworking class. The crib is 'in progress'.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Paul and Mike should start a retired dads club.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Wedding admin. RSVPs are due March 15, on the wedding website. There's a meal choice: vegetarian risotto or trout.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Got it.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Do NOT forget. Grace is tracking it in a spreadsheet and she will call you.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: I'll RSVP this week. Promise.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Also the bridal shower is April 18 in Albuquerque and I'm hosting. Pray for me.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: You'll make it beautiful.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: And my birthday is March 12, in case you need a hint: I want a set of pottery trimming tools. Mine are cheap and keep bending.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Trimming tools, noted. Any particular kind?

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: The ones with wooden handles. Not the plastic kit.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Got it.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: We moved yesterday! New address: 2240 N Kestrel Ave, Apt 2.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Yay! How was it?

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Alex and Hana helped, which was sweet, because Hana is very pregnant and mostly directed traffic.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Best job.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Gus survived the move in a cooler. The cast-iron pan rode on my lap.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Priorities.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: My bike commute is 25 minutes now. Sam's is 10 and he's insufferable about it.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Dog yet?

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Not until after the race. April.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Interview done!

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: And??

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: I think it went well. They asked a lot about the science fair. Decision by March 13.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: You'll get in.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Fingers crossed.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Confession: your book is still sitting by my front door. I keep forgetting to mail it. I'm so sorry.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: The Salt Orchard has been held hostage for four months.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: It's being well cared for! It's right next to my keys!

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Also we had freak thunder-snow yesterday and Juni hid in the bathtub for two hours.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Poor Juni.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: She's okay now. A weighted blanket helps.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Mom's visit was perfect. She loved Little Kettle and she and Juni are now best friends.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Did she reorganize your kitchen?

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Completely. I can't find my spatula.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: New apartment report: second floor, the back porch gets the morning sun, and we bought a used dining table from a neighbor for $80.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Bargain.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Gus has a new home on top of the fridge. He's thriving.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: How's the race training?

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Long run tomorrow. Ten miles if the knee cooperates.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Ten! Careful.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Your mug came out of the kiln! It's green with a wonky handle. I'm mailing it tomorrow.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: I can't wait!!

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Lower your expectations.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Never. I did my first 10-miler yesterday and the knee was totally fine.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Renee would be proud.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Seven weeks to race day.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Ethan and I are official, by the way.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: !!!! Sam is going to want a full report.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: He's a pediatric nurse at one of the hospitals here. Juni is warming up to him.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Also, no rush on the $75, but I'm writing it on your hand when you get here.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Ha. Fair.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Toast draft is attached. Be honest.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: It's lovely. Cut the second joke about Daniel's welding though, it's a little mean.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Fair. Cutting.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Grace's bridal shower theme is 'desert brunch'. I've ordered 40 tiny cactus favors.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Very on brand.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: My dad finished the crib! He sent a photo, it's actually beautiful.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Mike! Tell him I'm impressed.

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Hana cried. Alex pretended not to.

turns.speaker: Maddie Cho
turns.text: Is the mug there yet?

turns.speaker: Leo Brennan
turns.text: Not yet. Tracking says Thursday.
